milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch fence gate is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 4). The player spawns at (0, 0, 0), which is exactly 4 blocks away. max_distance=3 ensures the player must walk forward at least 1-2 blocks to come within range (4 > 3, so NOT pre-satisfied at spawn). facing_tolerance=45 requires the player to be deliberately looking at the gate, confirming visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an acacia_fence_gate results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with only a wooden axe — no acacia_fence_gate exists in the starting inventory. The full crafting chain is: mine acacia logs → craft acacia planks → craft sticks → craft acacia fence gate at the crafting table. Checking for min_count=1 reliably confirms the entire multi-step crafting process is complete.
